tasks.label: Build x64
tasks.command: $vswhere = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { Write-Error 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install the "Desktop development with C++" workload.'; exit 1 }; & $msbuild 'HopperRender.sln' /t:Rebuild /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64 /m /nologo /v:minimal; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'x64\Release\HopperRender.dll' -Destination 'x64\Release\HopperRender.x64.dll' -Force; Write-Host ('-> ' + (Resolve-Path 'x64\Release\HopperRender.x64.dll'))

Install the "Desktop development with C++" workload.'; exit 1 }; & $msbuild 'HopperRender.sln' /t:Rebuild /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=Win32 /m /nologo /v:minimal; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'Win32\Release\HopperRender.dll' -Destination 'Win32\Release\HopperRender.x86.dll' -Force; Write-Host ('-> ' + (Resolve-Path 'Win32\Release\HopperRender.x86.dll'))
